════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
7. HOW LFM SERVES AXIOM (vs PREVIOUS INTEGRATIONS)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Previous Axiom integration: Hermes agent called Physis via
  physisProClient.ts (REST). No model tiering, no speculative
  decoding, no tool-call pairing.

  New LFM Gateway improvements:
    1. Tiered inference — LFM2.5 (50 t/s) → ornith (15-20 t/s)
       → qwen3.8-27b (3-5 t/s). Confidence cascading saves cost.
    2. Tool calling pair — LFM2.5 executes tool calls while ornith
       reasons. 10x faster agent loop.
    3. Swarm mode — N LFM2.5 agents in parallel, ornith synthesizes.
    4. Physis coherence tracking — every tool call, every result
       is registered as a coherence node (+1 success / -1 failure).
    5. Daily brief — PDCA plan + coherence snapshot + LLM synthesis
       in one call.
    6. Notebook stack — incoming notes auto-classified against
       70-cell semiotic grid, llmwiki semantic search for context.

  Performance comparison:
    Previous: single model (~5-15 t/s), no caching, no tiering.
    Current:  LFM2.5 at ~50 t/s for trivial queries, ornith at
              ~15-20 t/s for reasoning, speculative decoding
              for 2-3x speedup on heavy model.

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
8. STREAMING PHYSIS ACROSS MACHINES
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Goal: Physis reachable from both omo and pansa with coherent state.

  Architecture:
    pansa: Physis master (sled DB, tenant state, dreams, PDCA)
    omo:   Physis streamer (local classify cache + proxy)

  Sync mechanism:
    - omo runs physis-stream daemon (systemd user unit)
    - Daemon proxies all requests to pansa master
    - classify/embedd are cached locally (1hr TTL, SQLite)
    - Writes (coherence, goals, PDCA) go directly to pansa
    - Reads (classify, search, ask) can hit either machine
    - Auth + tenant headers forwarded transparently

  Verified:
    omo:   curl -X POST localhost:19876/api/v1/classify → 200 OK
    pansa: curl -X POST localhost:19876/api/v1/classify → 200 OK
